sources.entry: GithubNotify - Simple macOS app to alert you when you have unread GitHub notifications.

summary.one_liner: GithubNotify is a macOS menubar app that changes color when you have unread GitHub notifications.
summary.what_it_does: Sits in the macOS menubar and changes its color when unread GitHub notifications are waiting. It authenticates with GitHub through an OAuth application the user registers, with permission to read notifications. The README offers a prebuilt release to unzip and run, or a source build using Carthage and xcodebuild. Building from source requires creating a GitHub OAuth app with the callback URL github-notify://oauth and storing its client ID and secret in a .secrets file. The README does not describe other features such as notification details, click actions, or preferences.
use_cases: see unread GitHub notifications from the menubar
avoid missing GitHub review requests and mentions
run a lightweight GitHub notification indicator on macOS
build a macOS GitHub notifier from source
how_to_run: Quick install: grab the latest release, unzip, and run GithubNotify
Create .secrets with GITHUB_OAUTH_ID and GITHUB_OAUTH_SECRET from your GitHub OAuth app (callback URL github-notify://oauth)
Or open GithubNotify.xcodeproj in Xcode and build there
notable: Menubar icon color reflects unread GitHub notification state
Prebuilt release available, so no build is needed for basic use
Builds from the command line with xcodebuild or in Xcode
caveats: Requires registering your own GitHub OAuth application to build from source
